title: Glowing Trims
description: A mod that adds glowing (emissive) armor trims! Includes version 26.2!
body:
![# Glowing Trims](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3eba564c6eff16ca6a1770c52f31efb36a74a3b5_0.webp)

Make every armor trim glow at full brightness.

Glowing Trims is a lightweight client-side mod that renders all armor trims at maximum brightness, making them clearly visible even in complete darkness.

Unlike similar mods, Glowing Trims supports multiple loaders and versions, including Fabric, NeoForge, and Forge, so it works for more players and modpacks. It also makes trims glow permanently without needing extra setup or resource pack tricks!

## Other: [Full Emissive](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fullemissive), [Glowing Armor](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/glowingarmor), and Discord

For more emissive textures go check out my resource packs [Full Emissive](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fullemissive) and [Glowing Armor](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/glowingarmor)!

Join my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/xyG2zPvpeC) for updates, bug reporting, suggesting, support, and more!

## Features

* 🌟 Permanently glowing armor trims
* 🎨 Works with every trim pattern and trim material
* 💡 Fullbright rendering in any light level
* 🪶 Lightweight client-side mod
* 🔧 No configuration required
* 📜 Fabric support - 26.2, 1.21.1
* 🦊 NeoForge support - 26.2, 1.21.1
* ⚒️ Forge support - 1.20.1

![# Glowing Trims](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/989d33db3690cdfdc415fbb320e05b7b00631153_0.webp)

## Recommendations

Emissive textures work best with Shaders! For better PCs I recommend using [Super Duper Vanilla](https://modrinth.com/project/LMIZZNxZ), and ensuring correct lighting settings are enabled. [Mellow](https://modrinth.com/shader/mellow) shaders also work really well for the lower end, really highlighting the emissive textures!
